linkedin.title: Searching for news used to mean digging through headlines until you found the right article.
linkedin.body:
Now, AI search tools can give you the answer directly. It feels like a shortcut, but it changes the relationship we have with information. Instead of exploring a topic by reading different perspectives, we are increasingly asking for a single, synthesized summary.

This is efficient, but it comes with a trade-off. When we only see the answer, we lose the context. We lose the nuance of how a story evolved. We stop seeing the full picture because the machine decided what was most important for us to know.

At Headlinne, we believe the future of news isn't just about getting faster answers. It is about getting better, more personalized context. The goal should be to help you stay informed without stripping away the depth that makes the news meaningful in the first place.

We are building a way to filter through the noise so you can find what actually matters to you, rather than just what the algorithm thinks you should see.

instagram.title: Trump names Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff

slides.headline: Trump names Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff
slides.subtitle: Miller is the architect of mass deportation plans

slides.explanation: Miller has been the driving force behind the administration's immigration strategy for years.

slides.headline: His past actions have drawn significant controversy
slides.explanation: Miller faced intense criticism earlier this year after ICE agents were involved in the deadly shooting of two protesters in Minneapolis.
Four independent outlets including France 24 and The Guardian confirmed this appointment. When major international newsrooms align on these details, it signals a high level of certainty.

slides.subtitle: Read the full report on Headlinne.

instagram.caption:
President Trump has selected immigration hardliner Stephen Miller to serve as his new chief of staff.

This appointment puts a central figure of the administration's deportation agenda in one of the most powerful positions in Washington.

Miller has long been the primary strategist for the White House on border policy. His work has previously drawn major controversy, particularly regarding his role in overseeing enforcement operations.

Most notably, Miller faced widespread scrutiny in January following an incident in Minneapolis. ICE agents were involved in the shooting deaths of two protesters, an event that became a flashpoint for critics of his approach to immigration enforcement.

story.title: Trump announces immigration hardliner Stephen Miller as new chief of staff
story.summary: US President Donald Trump on Friday said advisor Stephen Miller would become his new chief of staff. Miller has been instrumental in driving the Trump administration's mass deportation programme and faced particular criticism after the deadly shootings of two Minneapolis protesters by ICE agents in January.

story_card.headline: White House Network IP Addresses Are Being Rented Out
story_card.standfirst: Security researchers found that presidential network access is available for a few

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Outsiders can apparently rent access to the White House network for just a few dollars.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Security firms Layer3 Intel and Synthient found software running on the network allowing this.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The presidential network is now potentially exposed to unauthorized users.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Experts are waiting to see how the White House addresses this security vulnerability.

story_card.caption:
Security experts discovered that White House network IP addresses are being rented out online.

Research from Layer3 Intel and Synthient suggests software on the presidential network is enabling this access. It appears anyone with a few dollars could potentially use these residential connections. The findings were verified by multiple independent sources.
